name: Does AKN Design Group offer standalone interior paint repair services?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group offer standalone interior paint repair services?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in substantial, coordinated residential renovations, including custom kitchens, luxury bathrooms, whole-home remodels, and additions. Our focus is on comprehensive projects where paint repair is an integrated component of a larger transformation. We do not offer standalone, piecemeal interior paint repair services or small handyman-style tasks. Our expertise lies in managing complex renovations from design planning to final walkthrough, ensuring every detail, including painting, contributes to the overall enhanced functionality, beauty, and value of your home. Clients seeking isolated painting touch-ups are outside our specialized scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group specializes in substantial renovations and integrates paint repair into these larger projects. We do not offer standalone interior paint repair services or small handyman tasks.
